thread:
maria.chen: Heads up, weekly KPIs show webinar -> SAL conversion dropped ~28% last week vs 4wk baseline. Not sure if this is attribution or lead quality. Anyone tracking this?
kevin.park: I'm seeing the same in the dashboard. Which webinar are we looking at?
samir.patel: Can you confirm attribution window? Last-touch 7d vs multi-touch 30d will change the numbers.
jen.liu: Form completions actually rose slightly but avg session duration on the landing page dropped ~35%. Could be a different traffic source.
olivia (mktg-ops): I exported the raw leads from HubSpot. ~50 leads have empty utm_source for that webinar. Widget sometimes strips query params on redirect :/
analytics-bot: quick snapshot run:
```
SELECT attribution, COUNT(*) AS leads
FROM leads
WHERE webinar_id = '2026_03_16'
GROUP BY attribution;
-- last_touch: 243
-- first_touch: 310
-- blank_utm: 54
```
kevin.park: Blank utm lines up with the conversion delta. If blank_utm gets routed to generic nurture, SAL rate would drop.
maria.chen: Ok two fronts: fix form redirect/hidden field, and check partner/syndication traffic quality. Priority is fixing routing so we don't lose intent.
jen.liu: Proposal: for next webinar, route unknown-utm leads to a holding queue for 48h and run enrichment (email check + hidden webinar_id) before putting into regular nurture. Low lift in HubSpot.
samir.patel: I'll add a multi-touch (30d) toggle to the weekly report so we can compare. Putting methodology notes in the metrics doc so execs understand numbers.
olivia (mktg-ops): I can patch the widget redirect to preserve querystring and add a hidden webinar_id field. QA + deploy in ~2 business days. Will post PR.
kevin.park: I'll run a routing audit mapping blank_utm leads -> sequences and share a CSV by EOD Wed. Also will create a short SQL report breaking conversion by utm_source, utm_medium, and has_webinar_id flag.
maria.chen: Action list: (1) olivia implement hidden field + fix redirect (2 business days), (2) samir add multi-touch view to dashboard (EOD Thu), (3) kevin routing audit + conversion-by-utm report (EOD Wed), (4) jen audit partner referral quality and ask for proper referrer tags.
j en.liu: If olivia slips beyond 48h we enable temp routing: mark no-utm form completions from webinar landing page as "probable webinar" and route to SDR queue for manual triage.
olivia (mktg-ops): Friday 10am sync works. I'll aim to have the PR up today. :thumbsup:
analytics-bot: scheduled: weekly_leads_snapshot will post to #marketing_reports Fri 08:00
maria.chen: Thanks team. Ping me if you hit blockers and I'll escalate. :rocket:
